intro.text: A man from Sadeas's warcamp who moved to Urithiru, followed by his wife, Rem.

items.text: Ned was known as a very angry drunk. One night he strangled Rem when she tried to take him home from the bar, scraping her face with his ring. The next day a barmaid at All's Alley was killed the same way. Betha's thugs, who guarded the bar, took Ned for the killer, and Ur threw him off a high ledge though he denied it.
Shallan learned about Ned from Betha while looking into the murders in the tower.
